REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Trust-root validation is circular: it equates deployed trust material with mutable proposal files, not an immutable previously approved package. A trust-profile or key amendment therefore either requires predeployment before its gates pass or permits coordinated candidate/deployed tampering to appear reviewed.
FINDING: high|scripts/factory-ng-receipt-validate.py|verify_reviewed_trust_root compares the production trust root to current OPS repository files without binding them to a previously approved package digest|This cannot distinguish reviewed material from an unapproved proposal and violates the requirement that amendments have no production effect before Sol/Opus review and deterministic gates pass.
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Bind active trust material to an immutable previously approved package digest; validate proposed replacement material separately under the existing trust root, then activate it only after required reviews and gates. Add predeployment-rotation and coordinated-tampering rejection fixtures.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: Propose a new reviewer registry/key, copy the same unapproved files into /opt/development/factory-ng-trust, then run validation; equality succeeds and receipts signed by the new key can be accepted despite the proposal not yet completing review.
